steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Attend Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our Chattanooga-focused cohorts deliver the required formal education in a structured, accelerated format. Experienced instructors guide you through the PMBOK® Guide and real-world project scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: File your PMP application directly with PMI and pay the associated exam fee. Our team provides guidance on application documentation and deadlines. Once PMI approves your eligibility, you'll receive authorization to schedule your exam.

steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout the standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your PMP active. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education and resources to support your ongoing certification maintenance.
